data.summary: The extraction is broadly aligned with the PDS for many core plan limits, dates, eligibility rules and benefit amounts, but there are actionable issues in plan-specific geographic scope, omitted or incomplete duration/remains limits, inapplicable travel-delay thresholds, and an add-on attributed to Standard despite being Top-only. Some omissions are partly due to garbled table parsing, but several errors are directly resolvable from the parsed pages.

findings.reason: Basic is not available for Worldwide Including destinations, but the extracted geographic scope lists Worldwide Including as an offered region for this plan.
findings.source_quote: Worldwide* Including | No | No | Yes | Yes
findings.extracted_value: International destinations offered by region selection: Pacific; Asia; Worldwide Excluding (worldwide excluding USA, Canada, Mexico, Caribbean, Central & South America and Antarctica); Worldwide Including (worldwide including USA, Canada, Mexico, Caribbean, Central & South America). Select the plan for the destination where you will spend the majority of your trip, except where you will spend more than 48 hours in North America or South America, in which case select Worldwide Including. No cover is available for travel on commercial cruise ships and no cover for domestic travel within Australia. Sanctioned/embargoed countries excluded (see list).

findings.reason: Additional Specified Items Cover is included in Standard optional_add_ons even though the wording says it is only available with Top cover; noting it is unavailable inside an optional_add_ons list is inconsistent with the field definition.
findings.source_quote: only available if you have selected the Top level of cover

extracted_value.name: Winter sports cover
extracted_value.limits_summary: Adds Sections N1–N6 with specified limits (e.g., winter sports equipment $1,250; lift pass $500; ski pack $150 per 24 hours up to $600; piste closure $50 per 24 hours up to $500; avalanche $600).
extracted_value.evidence: Table of Benefits for Upgrades pages 16; Sections N pages 43-48

extracted_value.name: Natural disaster cover
extracted_value.limits_summary: Extends Sections A (Yes), C1 (Yes), and C2 (Yes) on Standard. Medical expenses due to natural disaster are included under Section B1 without this upgrade.

extracted_value.name: Excess Eliminator (excess waiver)
extracted_value.limits_summary: Removes standard $200 excess (except increased medical excesses for certain activities).
extracted_value.evidence: Excess section page 3; Important Information on excess page 16

extracted_value.name: Additional Specified Items Cover (E2)
extracted_value.limits_summary: Only available with Top plan per PDS; not available on Standard.
